items.title: Waarom Ajax op de linkerflank worstelde tegen PEC
items.summary: Ajax heeft via een slotoffensief toch de punten gepakt tegen PEC Zwolle: 0-2. Zonder Mika Godts als basisspeler kwamen de uitdagingen voor Míchel Sánchez naar de oppervlakte.

items.title: FC Groningen verpest FC Utrecht-debuut van Correia
items.summary: FC Groningen is in eigen huis aan het nieuwe Eredivisie-seizoen begonnen met een overwinning. Aanvallers Brynjólfur Willumsson en Thom van Bergen waren zondagmiddag trefzeker tegen FC Utrecht, waar trainer Anthony Correia debuteerde.

items.title: Invallers helpen stroef draaiend Ajax over de drempel tegen tiental PEC
items.summary: Ajax is foutloos begonnen aan het Eredivisie-seizoen, al ging dat niet van harte voor de Amsterdammers. De ploeg van Míchel Sánchez had het lastig op bezoek bij PEC Zwolle. Uiteindelijk trok Ajax tegen een Zwols tiental aan het langste eind.

items.title: VI Live: Brandt maakt zijn eerste voor Ajax
items.summary: Zondagmiddag gaat Ajax op bezoek bij PEC Zwolle. De Amsterdammers hopen de nare nasmaak van het vorige seizoen weg te spoelen. Verfrist met een flinke lading nieuwe spelers trapt Ajax het Eredivisie-seizoen om 14.30 uur af. Volg het duel in deze VI Live.

items.title: Brazilian top-flight club wear name of English fan with MND on shirts

items.title: VI Live: Heerenveen en Twente gaan openingsronde afsluiten
items.summary: Zondag staan er vier Eredivisie-duels op het programma. De wedstrijden van Feyenoord en Ajax volgen we in aparte liveblogs. In deze VI Live blijf je volledig op de hoogte van FC Groningen tegen FC Utrecht (14.30 uur) en SC Heerenveen tegen FC Twente (16.45 uur).

items.title: Fifa defends Gianni Infantino and launches attack after ‘effort to undermine’ president
items.summary: Fifa backs ‘democratically-elected’ president Thinly-veiled attack aimed on Uefa as crisis roars on Fifa last night issued a thinly-veiled attack on Uefa and other leading figures in European football in a statement which alleged there is a “concerted and ongoing effort by some to undermine Fifa and its president,” as football’s civil war escalated further. Uefa has made it clear they regard Infantino’s continued leadership of world football as untenable following his role in the World Cup sell-off plans, while the Guardian revealed on Friday the Norwegian Football Federation has publicly called on him to resign, with Fifa responding by accusing them of attempting to subvert the organisation’s democratic processes. Continue reading...

items.title: Unmasking London City's Spanish superstar
items.summary: Alexia Putellas' arrival at London City Lionesses was the biggest transfer in WSL history - but who is the person behind the global stardom?

items.title: Alexia Putellas: ‘I’m hungry to win, to fight with my teammates for victory’
items.summary: London City Lionesses’ headline signing talks expectations, the lure of playing in England and the prospect of being kicked by her former teammates Momentarily, Alexia Putellas appears somewhat nervous, stepping inside the cramped conference room in a Kent hotel to see 23 reporters squeezed inside, all eager to hear from the Women’s Super League’s newest global superstar, but she quickly composes herself. Within minutes, she is into her stride, asking for tips about roast dinners and drawing laughs from the room as she jokes that her friends who play for other English clubs have told her they are going to kick her. Welcome to the WSL. Speaking in English throughout the 20-minute session with ever-increasing proficiency, the two-time Ballon d’Or winner and four-time Champions League winner explains why she has swapped the prestige of Barcelona – where she has been idolised over a trophy-laden 14-year spell – for a team that finished 22 points adrift of the European qualification places last term. Continue reading...

items.title: ‘It’s a true art form’: Nigeria goalkeeper Maduka Okoye on high fashion and life at Udinese
items.summary: The former Watford player talks about his off-field pursuits, lessons from the World Cup and unfinished business When Maduka Okoye visited Paris fashion week for the Jean Paul Gaultier show, taking his seat in the front row alongside rapper Cardi B, the online reaction was swift. Within hours, footage of the Udinese and Nigeria goalkeeper was all over TikTok and Instagram – where his audience now stretches to nearly two million followers – transforming the appearance into a viral cultural moment that crossed beyond the boundaries of football. Yet ask Okoye to reflect on his sudden explosion into the fashion ecosystem, and he frames it not as a pursuit of celebrity or status, but as a genuine interest in art. “Being at the Paris fashion week was really impressive,” Okoye says. “It was my first time really coming into contact with high fashion, and it was fascinating. It’s a true art form. I enjoyed it immensely and since that moment I’ve become a much bigger fan of fashion than I was before.” Continue reading...

items.title: How Trabzonspor shocked Turkish rivals to make Mohamed Salah their Black Sea saviour
items.summary: Never before has a big name rejected Istanbul for Trabzon, but former Liverpool striker was offered more than riches It began with a text sent during the World Cup. Ertugrul Dogan, the president of Trabzonspor, was watching Egypt when he picked up his phone and messaged his manager, Fatih Tekke. “Coach,” it read. “Do you want Mohamed Salah?” Tekke’s response was immediate enthusiasm, though Trabzonspor’s initial push for Salah went under the radar with Besiktas looking most likely to land the former Liverpool striker. In Turkish football, Istanbul’s Big Three – Galatasaray, Fenerbahce and Besiktas – have long held monopoly on the Super Lig’s marquee signings. Continue reading...

items.title: Premier League managers have never been less English, title-winning or secure in their jobs
items.summary: Huge turnover between seasons means 11 clubs start 2026-27 led by people with under a year in their dugout Nine of the 20 Premier League clubs will begin the 2026-27 season with a different man in the dugout than the one who ended the last campaign. Opta recently revealed that the only other seasons which started with so many men making their managerial debut for top flight clubs were 1888-89 and 1946-47; the inaugural season of league football and the first following the second world war. Neither occurred under normal circumstances yet the level of turnover this summer does not feel unusual. Job security has never meant less in the Premier League. Adding in the recently appointed pair of Roberto De Zerbi and Michael Carrick – confirmed in March and May respectively – means this season will start with 11 teams led by coaches with less than a year in their hotseat. The median tenure of Premier League managers at the start of each season has never been so low. Continue reading...
